answers.explanation: Layer 1 means dealing with the systems and their environment before anything is ever connected.
"Is it plugged in?" still fixes a surprising number of problems. No light usually means no link.
Cameras, lights, and fences deter and record people approaching the site. The others work at the door or on the network.
If they can see in, they can read whatever's on the screen.
Each checks who you are before the door opens: a badge, a PIN, or your body.
Separating networks, hosts, and LANs keeps one breach from reaching everything.
Phones inside a Faraday cage lose signal, and nothing inside can be picked up from outside.
A Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility, usually pronounced "skiff".
Physical access beats most digital defenses. That's why physical security comes first.
